notes: ACCESS: pbteen.com is Akamai-fronted; curl_cffi impersonation reached it on every request this session (winning profiles safari15_5, safari17_0, safari17_2_ios; desktop chrome/edge profiles intermittently 403 or time out, so a random-profile retry loop was used). r.jina.ai, the route used in the prior Home-Decor pass, is dead for this workstation. robots.txt was fetched FIRST: EasouSpider is disallowed entirely, Pinterestbot gets crawl-delay 0.2, and the 'User-agent: *' group names no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web agent; it disallows only /account/, /checkout/, /shoppingcart/, /services/, */minipip, */quicklook, /*N=, */order-shipment-tracking, */registry/list.json, */undefined and '/shop/*+*+*' facet URLs. Every URL emitted is a plain /shop/<supercat>/<node>/ path, so nothing here is disallowed and no Crawl-delay applies to '*'. probe.py's 2s/host pacing was used. TREE: taken from PB Teen's OWN mega-menu payload, https://www.pbteen.com/api/catalog/v1/category/categorytree/shop/data.json (786 KB), in which type='header' nodes are grouping rows, type='subcat' nodes are leaves and secret=true marks nodes hidden from the rendered navigation. That mapping was verified against the live pages: the flyout HTML actually served on https://www.pbteen.com/shop/bath/ and https://www.pbteen.com/shop/dorm/ was scraped and matches the non-secret nodes exactly. Cross-checked against the shop sitemap https://www.pbteen.com/netstorage/sitemaps/shop-sitemap-1.xml.gz (612 URLs - every emitted link is present verbatim) and against constructor.io's group tree (group_id=bath returns 16 child groups, group_id=dorm carries the Bath & Laundry leaves; every recorded leaf has children=[] and parents=['all','bath'] or ['all','dorm'], so the taxonomy is two levels deep). WHAT THE BATH DEPARTMENT ACTUALLY CONTAINS: PB Teen's Bath supercat has five displayed headers - Towels & Linens, Bathroom Organization, Bathroom Decor, Robes & Pajamas, Beach Towels - plus In-Stock, Best Selling and a 'Dorm Bath & Laundry' pointer. Only Bathroom Organization yields Bathroom leaves under the category rules: Bathroom Storage & Accessories, Shower Caddies and Bathroom Mirrors. The site sells NO sanitaryware, baths, taps, toilets, showers or enclosures - it is a teen/dorm brand - so those parts of the Bathroom taxonomy are legitimately absent, not missed. The second real source of Bathroom leaves is the Dorm supercat's 'Bath & Laundry' header, whose Shower Caddies and Bath Storage & Accessories nodes are separate URLs from the Bath supercat's and are recorded separately per rule 28 (their assortments overlap heavily - 34 vs 35 items - but no quantity is ever combined; each row carries only its own page's total). The header nodes themselves are navigation-only: /shop/bath/bathroom-accessories/ (Towels & Linens), /shop/bath/bathroom-decor-category/, /shop/bath/robes-pajamas-category/ and /shop/dorm/bath-and-laundry/ all return total_num_results=0 in the site's own product engine, and /shop/bath/bathroom-organization/ returns 1, so all are emitted as grouping rows with blank qty and blank link (rule 24). QTY: PB Teen's PLP is client-rendered - the served HTML carries the H1 and breadcrumb but no product total - so every number is response.total_num_results from the storefront's OWN product API, https://ac.cnstrc.com/browse/group_id/<slug>?key=key_QdCsKhJzRGmFMX0N, the key read live out of the PLP's __INITIAL_STATE__ (constructor variant 'treatmentSearchEngineConstructor', enabled=true), alongside productCountDisplay={displayText:'Items', isEnabled:true, viewAllProductsJumpLink.enabled={desktop:true,mobile:true}} - the 'View N Items' jump-link variant PB Teen renders. VERIFICATION - three independent checks. (1) SOURCE CHAIN, read out of the live WSI storefront bundle dist/shop.cd506c32.js, which declares POTTERY_BRANDS=['PB','PK','PT'] and so serves pbteen: it assigns 'v.response.numFound = e.response.total_num_results' from this exact browse call, defines productCount() as '(state.shop.cat.response.numFound) || 0' and builds the rendered count message from productCount + productCountDisplayConfig.displayText. total_num_results IS the number PB Teen prints, not a proxy. (2) ENUMERATION TO EXHAUSTION on all five recorded leaves, paged out at 100 results/page with unique product ids counted: bathroom-storage 57/57, shower-caddies 35/35, bathroom-mirrors 46/46, dorm shower caddies 34/34, dorm bath storage & accessories 40/40 - exact matches to total_num_results in every case. (3) IDENTITY + CONTENT: each leaf URL was fetched and its server-rendered H1 / __INITIAL_STATE__ categoryNames confirmed, and each leaf's first page of products was read to confirm the assortment matches the label - Bathroom Mirrors really is mirrors (Forget-Me-Knot Bow Mirror, Gold Double-Wide Arch Mirror, AERIN Bamboo Wall Mirror, Audrey Storage Mirror), Shower Caddies really is shower caddies. Counts discriminate per category (34 to 57) and no filter/store/zip pre_filter_expression was attached. EXCLUDED: 'All Bath Linens', 'All Bathroom Organization', 'All Bath Linens, Beach & Organization', 'All Bath & Laundry' and 'Shop All Bath' as View-All (rule 25); 'All In-Stock Bath & Beach' as an availability filter; 'Bath Best Sellers', 'Bath & Beach Sale', 'Pajamas & Robes Sale', 'New Arrivals' and 'Sorority Shop' as promotional; and the cross-brand linkcats to potterybarnkids.com and potterybarn.com, which are other companies' sites. ROUTED OUT (recorded in review with qty and URL, not in rows): Bath Towels & Wraps, Shower Curtains & Bath Mats, Bath Mats, Beach Towels, Robes & Pajamas and the Dorm equivalents -> Textile; the two 'Laundry' nodes -> Storage; 'Bathroom Decor' and Decor > 'Bathroom & Laundry' held back as mixed/overlapping aggregates; the two beauty/vanity-mirror nodes held back as LOW-confidence per rule 29; Dorm Storage > 'Bath and Jewelry Storage' and the legacy /shop/dorm-bath/ tree held back as duplicates. PB Teen has no Bathroom Lighting node - its Lighting supercat and Dorm > Lighting carry no bathroom/vanity sub-node - so nothing was routed to Lighting. KEPT DELIBERATELY: Bathroom Mirrors as Bathroom rather than Wall Decor, because the primary product type is a mirror and the node sits inside Bath > Bathroom Organization (rules 10/11/21); Bathroom Storage & Accessories as Bathroom storage/organizers under rule 12 even though some of its items are beauty carts, because PB Teen's own Bath hierarchy owns the node; the Dorm shower-caddy and bath-accessory nodes because caddies are explicitly Bathroom under rules 6/13. PB Teen's 'vanity' furniture (Furniture > Vanities, Study > Vanity Desks / Vanity Chairs, Decor > Vanities & Storage Furniture) was inspected and DEPRECATED from Bathroom per rule 29: those are bedroom makeup-vanity desks and stools, not bathroom vanity units, and they were already captured by the Furniture pass. BREADCRUMB EVIDENCE (final check): every recorded leaf URL was re-fetched and its __INITIAL_STATE__ analytics.pageCategory.categoryNames read back - /shop/bath/bathroom-storage/ -> ["Teen Bathroom Decor & Accessories","Bathroom Organization","Bathroom Storage + Accessories"]; /shop/bath/shower-caddies/ -> [...,"Bathroom Organization","Shower Caddies"]; /shop/bath/bathroom-mirrors/ -> [...,"Bathroom Organization","Bathroom Mirrors"]; /shop/dorm/bath-bats-and-shower-curtains/ -> ["Dorm","Dorm Bath & Laundry","Shower Caddies"]; /shop/dorm/shower-caddies-bath-accessories/ -> ["Dorm","Dorm Bath & Laundry","Bath Storage & Accessories"]. This confirms both the node identity and the three-level path used for the grouping rows (the Bath supercat renders as 'Teen Bathroom Decor & Accessories', with 'Bathroom Organization' as the intermediate group).
